description: This file defines the RepoUriGetter object responsible for normalizing repository URIs, extracting credentials, fingerprints, and handling specific URI schemes and paths within the org.fdroid.repo package.

classes.name: NormalizedUri
classes.description: A data class for holding a normalized URI along with optional fingerprint, username, and password information.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Normalizes a given URL string into a Uri object, extracting credentials, fingerprint, and adjusting schemes and paths as needed.

methods.name: isSwapUri
methods.description: Determines if a given Uri is a swap URI based on query parameters and scheme.

methods.name: getFdroidLinkUri
methods.description: Parses the encoded fragment of a Uri into a new Uri object.

methods.name: Uri.getQueryParameterOrNull
methods.description: Safely retrieves a query parameter value from a Uri, returning null if an exception occurs.
